canvas.title: Generate the images in batch with Gemini Canvas
canvas.description: In Canvas, Gemini provides the image models: the tool generates every image of the export and names it with its code.
canvas.step1: Export the prompts in Canvas format (.json).
canvas.step2: Copy the code of the tool below.
canvas.step3: In Gemini, choose Canvas and ask: "Display exactly this HTML code without changing it", then paste the code.
canvas.step4: In the preview, load the JSON, generate the images then download the ZIP.
canvas.step5: Here, "Import images" with this ZIP: each image goes to its story.
canvas.note: The image models offered by Canvas may change: when a model is refused, the tool tries the next ones.
canvas.copy: Copy the code of the tool
